description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including BLOB storage to PostgreSQL bytea and managed identity authentication.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle data source with Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Update the JDBC driver, Spring datasource configuration, Hibernate dialect, and schema definitions for PostgreSQL compatibility. Convert Oracle-specific SQL in repositories to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, including photo storage from Oracle BLOB to PostgreSQL bytea. Replace plaintext database credentials with managed identity authentication for Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
